shortDescription: Five military officers were injured in a helicopter crash in Jordan during a training exercise, the country's armed forces general command said on Wednesday.One officer was seriously hurt in the Black Hawk helicopter's crash and the four others suffered light injuries, the military said.

children: Five military officers were injured in a helicopter crash in Jordan during a training exercise, the country's armed forces general command said on Wednesday.
